newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says coal price hike less than $3/tonne.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says coal price hike less than $3/tonne.

text.p: Price increases achieved by The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd for shipments of hard coal to Japanese steelmakers next year were less than US$3 a tonne over last year's average price of $52 a tonne, BHP said on Tuesday.
"On the hard coking coal end we got modest increases ... not in the $3.00 a tonne range, modest is a bit lower than that," a BHP spokesman said.
"In the semi-soft coals, we've had price decreases," he added.
He declined to state the actual price variations.
BHP has agreed to sell 11 million tonnes of coking coal to Japanese steel mills for the year starting April 1, 1997, the company said earlier on Tuesday.
It said modest price increases had been achieved at the premium end of the hard coking coal market, while prices for lower quality coals had decreased.
